definitions.denominator: All selected labeled episodes, including missing, failed and malformed predictions.
definitions.hit_at_tolerance: Correctly predicted failure AND valid evidence onset within tolerance / all ground-truth failures.
definitions.conditional_onset_mae_seconds: Mean absolute onset error among ground-truth failures predicted failure with a valid onset; always read with valid_onset_coverage.
definitions.valid_onset_coverage: Ground-truth failures detected with a valid onset / all ground-truth failures.
definitions.success_false_alarm_rate: Predicted failure / all true successes; abstentions remain in the denominator.
definitions.sampler_oracle: Nearest selected measured timestamp within tolerance / all true failures, regardless of model verdict. Missing/invalid selections count uncovered. This measures sampling resolution, not visual observability.
definitions.invalid_onset: A binary failure verdict with an invalid onset remains a detected failure but cannot count as localized or a hit.
definitions.scope: Offline retrospective diagnosis using whole-recording sampling, not streaming detection latency.

limits: 8 tasks, one success and one failure each: natural class prevalence is changed.
Some author reason text was encountered during source research; selection used stable hashes and class strata, not onset, failure type, reason or observed model scores.
Offline full-recording diagnosis and one overview camera; no online latency, training or control claims.
Both models use the same frozen prompt, 12-frame budget, exact panel bytes and sampler selections.
Model identity differs; this is not an isolated parameter-count, architecture or training-data experiment.
No tuning, inference or new selection is performed by this comparison.
Task-cluster intervals are descriptive on this small stratified subset. Missing/failed outputs remain abstentions in all paired denominators.
Ground-truth onsets are author annotations; displayed visual evidence and annotated failure onset can differ.
